notes.title: Koira - Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Heeeey Puppy Lovers![/b]

Patch 1.0.7 is out with some sweet little bug fixes here:

- Rare crash that could occur when picking up the stick during the first tug-of-war moment
- Added proper credits for the FMOD plugin used with Godot - thank you for the magic!
- Resolved an issue where players couldn't jump of the cliff at the end of the Battue sequence
- Some various other small bugs

Snuggle up and enjoy your time with your loyal companion <3
